sans.$description: UI text (Barlow Medium). Not a Figma variable: the Sans Serif/* text styles name the family directly, so it is declared in code.

mono.$description: Mono text styles (Figma text styles Mono/Giga … Mono/Overline: Share Tech Mono Regular; size / line height / weight are bound to the Typography variables, weight Medium). The family is not a Figma variable, so it is declared in code.
